description: Centrale idroelettrica autorizzata. PTRC 2020 is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by idt2-geoserver.regione.veneto.it. Authorised hydroelectric power plant with an operational capacity exceeding 10 mw, point element related to tav.3. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Authorised hydroelectric power plant. PTRC 2020" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include PTRC2020, open data. The listing shows 6 download or service links in WFS, WMS, SHP, WMTS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
